meta.title: Vendor Approval Levels (vendor.approval.levels) = 0 (below the allowed range)
gaps: Open the tenant configuration for `vendor.approval.levels` as a Tenant Admin.
Attempt to save the value 0 and verify the allowed range refusal of 1–5.
Read the stored `vendor.approval.levels` value and verify it is not 0.
